DexLadder

Privacy Policy

Applies to the DexLadder mobile app and to dexladder.com. Effective 5 September 2026.

DexLadder does not collect any personal data. There is no account, no sign-up and no login. We operate no server that receives your activity, we run no analytics, we serve no advertising, and we embed no third-party tracking SDKs. Nothing you do in the app is transmitted to us, because there is nothing on our side to transmit it to.

1. Information we collect

None. We do not collect, store, sell, share or process personal information of any kind. We do not ask for your name, email address, phone number, date of birth, wallet address or payment details, and the app has no field in which to enter them.

We do not collect device identifiers, advertising identifiers (IDFA), location, contacts, photos, health data or usage analytics. The app does not request App Tracking Transparency permission because it does not track you, in Apple's sense or in any other.

2. Information stored on your device

So that the app is useful between sessions, it keeps the following on the device itself, in the app's own private storage:

  • your settings and display preferences (theme, currency, layout);
  • your simulated portfolio, simulated orders, watchlists and trade journal notes;
  • your lesson, lab and quiz progress, experience points and certificates;
  • a short-lived cache of the market and news data most recently fetched, so the app can open offline.

This information never leaves your device. It is not readable by us. Deleting the app deletes all of it. You can also clear it from inside the app, or export it yourself as a backup file — that file is created by you, saved where you choose, and is never uploaded anywhere.

3. Requests the app makes to other services

To show live prices, on-chain data and news headlines, the app reads public, read-only endpoints operated by third parties. These requests are anonymous: they carry no account, no identifier and no information about you, and they are read-only — the app never sends your data to them.

The services contacted include:

  • Market data — CoinGecko, Coinlore, CoinPaprika, Binance, Coinbase Exchange, GeckoTerminal, DefiLlama, Hyperliquid, Deribit.
  • Blockchain data — Blockchair, Blockstream, mempool.space, bitnodes.io, and public RPC endpoints for Ethereum, Solana, Polygon, BNB Chain, Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, Avalanche, Tron and XRPL.
  • Market sentiment and prediction-market odds — alternative.me (Fear & Greed Index), Polymarket's public Gamma API.
  • News — the public RSS feeds of Cointelegraph, CoinDesk, Decrypt, Bitcoin Magazine, CryptoSlate and The Block.
  • Images — coin logos and article thumbnails served by the publishers above and by YouTube's public thumbnail host.

As with any internet request, the operator of the service you are reading necessarily sees the connection itself — typically your IP address, the time, and the URL requested. That data is handled under their privacy policies, not ours, and we receive no copy of it. Opening an external link (a news article, a block explorer, a video) hands you to your browser and to that site's own policy.

4. Photos

If you choose to save a completion certificate or a share card, the app writes that single image to your photo library at the moment you tap save. It never reads, browses or uploads your photo library.

5. Money

DexLadder is a simulator. All balances, orders, fills and positions in it are paper — simulated against real prices. There are no in-app purchases, no subscriptions, no deposits, no withdrawals and no custody of any asset. The app cannot move real money or real cryptocurrency, and it never asks for a private key, seed phrase or wallet connection.

6. Children

DexLadder is rated 13+ and is not directed to children under 13. We knowingly collect no data from anyone, of any age.

7. Your rights

Rights such as access, correction, deletion, portability and objection exist in relation to data a company holds about you. We hold none. Your data is already entirely in your possession, on your own device, and you can delete it at any time by clearing it in the app or removing the app.

8. Changes

If this policy changes, the revised version will be published on this page with a new effective date. Material changes will also be noted in the app's release notes.

9. Contact

Questions about this policy: dexladder@gmail.com.
